scope: Exact arithmetic model checks and finite correlation identity audit; no universal Goldbach claim

python_producer.method: Trial division primality, incremental CRT, direct enumeration modulo 210, exact fractions, and factorization by trial division

independent_sage_verifier.method: Sage primality and integer factorization, Sage CRT, direct residue enumeration, exact QQ arithmetic, and direct representation-set enumeration

result.centers: even N from 4 through 100 inclusive; targets N-2, N, N+2

resource_notes: No packages installed. Small deterministic loops; peak memory was not separately measured.
analytic_proof_dependencies: Linnik least-prime theorem for a reduced residue class
Euler divergence of the sum of reciprocals of primes
limitations: Finite checks do not estimate or certify actual Goldbach representation counts beyond their explicitly enumerated small targets.
The infinite signed-profile result is about the Hardy-Littlewood arithmetic model, not actual prime-pair counts.
Universal coverage of the original three-case conjecture remains open.
